name: How much does basement trim installation typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does basement trim installation typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement trim costs depend heavily on the linear footage, material selected, and the level of custom carpentry required. A basic baseboard and door casing package using primed MDF or standard finger-jointed pine costs substantially less than custom multi-piece baseboards, window sills, and crown molding made from clear hardwoods or PVC. Additional labor factors include scribing trim against uneven concrete subfloors, framing adjustments, and whether you want the contractor to handle full caulking, hole-filling, and two-coat finish painting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on linear footage, material choice like MDF versus moisture-resistant PVC, and whether custom scribing, caulking, and finish painting are included.
